snippet.title: Sonic Colors VN: 2024 Showcase
snippet.description:
Credits
Sonic - ShibouVO
Tails - Peanut1105
Blaze - MC. Gemstone

The Colors Initiative is a project dedicated to preserving the history of Sonic Colors and all of its adaptations!

Sonic Colors VN is a remake of "Sonic Colors" DS in a visual novel format containing story elements originating from every official version of the game.

#sonicthehedgehog #soniccolors  #visualnovel
